name: icon-studio
description: Generate icon sets from a parameter list — original metaphors, hand-authored SVG, and a real-size contact sheet that proves each icon works before you ship it.
author: mxiaomen
highlights: Describe the behaviour, not the picture — the agent proposes three structurally different metaphors before it draws
Every icon is hand-authored SVG on a half-pixel grid, not traced or pulled from a library
A contact sheet renders every icon at its real target size in light and dark, so nothing ships unverified
A per-workspace metaphor ledger stops two icons in a set from resolving to the same silhouette
